questions.question: What features should the recipe explorer include?
questions.answer: Browse meal categories and category recipes from TheMealDB; search meals; show recipe details and ingredients; use typed server-only API helpers with the requested revalidation intervals; include category static parameters, metadata, unknown-category handling, and image configuration. Explain force-cache, revalidate, no-store, and the Next.js 15 versus 14 caching differences. Add a favourites feature using a validated HTTP-only JSON cookie capped at 50 meal IDs; a client heart button using useOptimistic and a Server Action; a /favourites Server Component that reads cookies() and fetches saved meals in parallel; and a random recipe button using random.php with revalidate: 0. Run npm run lint and npm run build, explain static versus dynamic routes, deploy to Vercel, and write the README.
questions.recommendedChoice: Browse meal categories and category recipes from TheMealDB; search meals; show recipe details and ingredients; use typed server-only API helpers with the requested revalidation intervals; include category static parameters, metadata, unknown-category handling, and image configuration. Explain force-cache, revalidate, no-store, and the Next.js 15 versus 14 caching differences.
